item.title: It's looking more likely that the northern lights will be visible tonight
item.description: A severe geomagnetic storm (G4) has caused the northern lights to be visible in the southern sky, and can be seen with the naked eye as a pinkish glow or picked up by a phone's camera.

item.title: Winter cold takes a breather, next attack could bring snow
item.description: A cold front is expected to bring frigid temperatures and possible snow to the region this week, with an extended period of dangerous cold to follow.

item.title: Woman dies in single-vehicle crash in Berryville, Ark.
item.description: Heather Lehr, 56, of Berryville, Arkansas, died after her 2023 Chevrolet Bolt crashed into a concrete wall while driving westbound on U.S. Highway 62.

item.title: Last week’s Springfield restaurant health code violations, Jan. 12-16
item.description: Health code violations were found in 27 Springfield restaurants during the week of January 12-16, including improper food storage, unsanitary conditions, and incorrect labeling.
